name: Auto Link Field Formatter
description: A field formatter that converts plain-text URLs in string/text fields into clickable links on the entity display.
project_description: Auto Link Field Formatter provides a single core Field Formatter plugin, 'auto_link_formatter' (label 'Auto Link (Convert URLs to Links)'), that renders string and text fields with their plain-text URLs turned into clickable anchor tags. It scans each field value for substrings beginning with http://, https:// or www. and wraps them in <a> tags (bare www. links are prefixed with http://), preserving line breaks via nl2br(). The formatter has one setting, 'Open links in new tab' (default on), which adds target="_blank" and always emits rel="noopener noreferrer". It targets the string, string_long, text and text_long field types and is selectable per view-display on Manage display and inside Layout Builder. The module declares a dependency on core Filter but ships no filter plugin, no permissions, no routes, no services, no Drush commands and no config schema of its own.
